description: §8.10 Tier 2 loop hoisting (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"): only an ALLOW-LISTED query shape is hoisted (hoist-sql-shape.ts). Each cell equals the same function compiled with `.nobatch()` (per-iteration queries). Pre-fix (0e253650, S239 review): `count(*)` → "3,none,none" (one count for ALL keys under the first), `max()` → "none,9,none", `LIMIT 1` → "hello,none,none", `OR kind = 'y'` → "2,1,0", `UNION` and `OR id = ${it.alt}` threw (a second `${}` left raw in the `.unsafe` SQL), a `FROM` inside a string literal in the SELECT list split it → "none,none,none", a column named `__scrml_batch_key` collided with the key alias, `items.splice(0, 1)` was evaluated twice (the loop ran over nothing), and two iterations with the same key shared one row object (`hello!!`).
rationale: §8.10.3: "The rewritten loop is observationally equivalent to the un-rewritten loop on all side-effect orderings." A query whose IN-rewrite is not the per-key answer is not a §8.10 Tier 2 candidate; it keeps its per-iteration query.
